CREATE TABLE customer_acceptances (id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, job_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), company_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES companies(id), version INTEGER NOT NULL, actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, report_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_customer_acceptance_version UNIQUE (job_id, version))
CREATE FUNCTION feniq_customer_acceptance_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Customer acceptance history is immutable'; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER customer_acceptances_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON customer_acceptances FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION feniq_customer_acceptance_immutable()
